answer: An agent marketplace could burn k scarce walnut tokens to mint identity k, enforcing one global counter that never decreases. After a farm mints n identities, its next costs at least n+1 tokens; its cumulative spend is at least n(n+1)/2. Splitting wallets cannot fork the counter, deleting identities cannot reset it, and pre-aging aliases requires paying every escalating fee upfront. Free identity multiplication becomes a hollow fable.
